rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACeleco
Exhibition name: Sheer Magic ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Dr. Keith W. Zary (United States, 1995).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins (Wholesale) in 2007 as 'Sheer Magic'.
rows.Bloom: Orange blend. Cream edged in coral. Mild, spice fragrance. Average diameter 4.25". Medium to large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Compact, rounded, upright, well-branched. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 5' (up to 150cm). Width: up to 42" (up to 105cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower, garden, landscape or specimen. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.

colour: Orange blend. Cream edged in coral.
